title: The Portrait
subtitle: A museum-grade bust, sculpted from your photographs.
description: The most personal object we make. Our artists translate three to five photographs into a digital sculpture, refine it with you, then print it in fine layers and hand-finish every surface. Each portrait arrives numbered with a certificate and a felt-lined plinth.

images.alt: A hand-finished portrait bust on a felt-lined plinth

forma.care: Dust gently with a soft brush. Keep away from direct sunlight and moisture.
forma.designer_note: Sculpted by hand from reference photographs. Portrait pricing is not yet published.

seo.title: The Portrait — a sculpted likeness by FORMA
seo.description: A museum-grade portrait bust sculpted from your photographs and hand-finished in the studio.

title: Möbius Vase
subtitle: A continuous fluted form in recycled ceramic.
description: A vase with no obvious beginning or end. Its fluted surface is generated by a single mathematical curve, then printed in recycled ceramic and hand-sanded to a chalk-soft finish. Watertight, with a removable glass insert for cut flowers.

images.alt: The Möbius Vase in a soft sage finish

forma.care: Wipe with a damp cloth. The removable glass insert is dishwasher safe.
forma.designer_note: A single mathematical curve, printed in recycled ceramic and hand-sanded.

seo.title: Möbius Vase — recycled ceramic by FORMA
seo.description: A continuous fluted vase in recycled ceramic, with a removable glass insert.

title: Halo Lamp
subtitle: A warm pool of light beneath a hand-finished shade.
description: A small lamp with a large presence. The Halo shade is printed thinly enough to glow from within, while its weighted base keeps it steady. Dimmable through a soft-touch dial, with a warm 2700K bulb included.

images.alt: The Halo Lamp glowing warm on a side table

forma.care: Dust with a soft cloth. Use only the supplied 2700K bulb.
forma.designer_note: Printed thin enough to glow, with a weighted base and a soft-touch dimmer.

seo.title: Halo Lamp — a warm, translucent table lamp
seo.description: A hand-finished table lamp with a translucent shade and a warm 2700K bulb.

title: Terra Planter
subtitle: A quiet home for small green things.
description: A tapered, gently ribbed planter with a removable inner cup and hidden water reservoir. Suitable for houseplants and herbs. The exterior is printed in a textured mineral finish that deepens with age.

images.alt: The Terra Planter in a textured mineral finish

forma.care: Rinse the inner cup before planting. Wipe the exterior with a damp cloth.
forma.designer_note: A tapered, ribbed form with a removable inner cup and hidden reservoir.

seo.title: Terra Planter — a sculptural planter by FORMA
seo.description: A tapered planter with a removable inner cup and hidden water reservoir.

title: Orbit Desk System
subtitle: Tray, dock, and pen well in one weighted piece.
description: A quiet place for the things that gather on a desk. Orbit combines a shallow catch tray, a magnetic phone dock, and a removable pen well in a single weighted body. Lined with recycled felt underneath to protect surfaces.

images.alt: The Orbit Desk System in graphite

forma.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. The felt base can be refreshed with a lint roller.
forma.designer_note: A single weighted body with a magnetic dock, catch tray, and removable pen well.

seo.title: Orbit Desk System — a weighted desk tray by FORMA
seo.description: A desk tray, magnetic phone dock, and pen well in one weighted piece.

title: Aster Ring
subtitle: A faceted band lost-cast in recycled silver.
description: Modelled digitally, printed in castable resin, then lost-cast in recycled sterling silver. The Aster has thirteen quiet facets that catch the light without asking for attention. Made to order in whole sizes 5–12.

images.alt: The Aster Ring in recycled silver

forma.care: Polish with a soft cloth. Remove before swimming or handling harsh chemicals.
forma.designer_note: Thirteen quiet facets, printed in castable resin and lost-cast in recycled silver.

seo.title: Aster Ring — recycled silver by FORMA
seo.description: A faceted band lost-cast in recycled sterling silver and finished by hand.

title: Kite Tabletop Set
subtitle: A pocket-sized ruin in nine modular pieces.
description: A small, modular ruin for tabletop play. Nine pieces click together in any arrangement, from a lone watchtower to a forgotten courtyard. Printed in durable resin with a dry stone finish; supplied with a felt storage pouch.

images.alt: The Kite Tabletop Set arranged as a small ruin

forma.care: Store in the supplied pouch. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight.
forma.designer_note: Nine modular pieces that click together in any arrangement.

seo.title: Kite Tabletop Set — modular terrain by FORMA
seo.description: A nine-piece modular ruin for tabletop play, printed in durable resin.

title: Echo Architectural Model
subtitle: A 1:200 study in fine white layers.
description: A presentation-grade architectural model for a real or imagined house. We work from your drawings or our studio brief, print at 0.08 mm layers, then assemble and finish. Scale and site footprint are tailored to your project.

images.alt: The Echo architectural model in bone white

forma.care: Dust with a soft brush. Keep away from direct heat and moisture.
forma.designer_note: Printed at 0.08 mm layers, assembled and finished by hand. Scale and footprint are tailored to the project.

seo.title: Echo Architectural Model — presentation models by FORMA
seo.description: A presentation-grade architectural model printed at fine layers and finished by hand.

title: Pulse Drone Frame
subtitle: A stiff, lightweight five-inch frame.
description: A five-inch freestyle frame, designed in-house and printed in carbon-fibre nylon. The arms flex on impact, then return to true. Standard 30.5 × 30.5 mm stack pattern, 20 × 20 mm motor mounts, and a replaceable camera cage.

images.alt: The Pulse Drone Frame in carbon-fibre nylon

forma.care: Inspect arms and mounts after impact. Replace damaged parts before flight.
forma.designer_note: A five-inch freestyle frame with a standard stack pattern and replaceable camera cage.

seo.title: Pulse Drone Frame — carbon-fibre nylon by FORMA
seo.description: A stiff, lightweight five-inch freestyle drone frame printed in carbon-fibre nylon.

title: Companion No. 4
subtitle: A numbered sculptural figure in soft-touch resin.
description: The fourth character in our Companion series. Printed in a single piece in soft-touch resin, then hand-finished with a brushed metal visor. Each edition is numbered, stamped, and accompanied by a small printed story.

images.alt: Companion No. 4 with a brushed metal visor

forma.care: Dust gently. Avoid handling the brushed visor with bare hands.
forma.designer_note: The fourth character in the Companion series, hand-finished with a brushed metal visor.

seo.title: Companion No. 4 — a numbered edition by FORMA
seo.description: A numbered sculptural figure in soft-touch resin with a hand-brushed metal visor.

title: Atelier Phone Dock
subtitle: A weighted dock with a soft felt seat.
description: A small, heavy dock cut from a single block of printed composite. The 68-degree angle keeps your phone at a glance, while the felt-lined seat protects the finish. Charges through the side, cable routed underneath.

images.alt: The Atelier Phone Dock in graphite

forma.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Keep the felt seat free of grit.
forma.designer_note: A single weighted block at a 68-degree viewing angle, with a felt-lined seat.

seo.title: Atelier Phone Dock — a weighted desk dock by FORMA
seo.description: A weighted phone dock with a felt-lined seat and a 68-degree viewing angle.

title: Marlowe Shift Knob
subtitle: A weighted knob in matte graphite and brass.
description: A heavy, warm object for a car you love. The Marlowe is printed in a dense composite, weighted with a brass core, and finished in soft-touch graphite. Made to your thread pitch, with a small engraved initial included.

images.alt: The Marlowe Shift Knob in matte graphite and brass

forma.care: Wipe with a soft cloth. Avoid abrasive cleaners on the brass accent.
forma.designer_note: A dense composite body with a brass core, made to the selected thread pitch.

seo.title: Marlowe Shift Knob — weighted and made to thread
seo.description: A weighted shift knob in matte graphite with a brass core, made to your thread pitch.

title: Arc Topper
subtitle: A delicate keepsake arc for the cake — and after.
description: A minimal celebration arch, printed in a food-safe finish and hand-polished. Personalise it with up to two names and a date, engraved in a fine serif. It becomes a small object for the shelf after the cake is gone.

images.alt: The Arc Topper in a pearl finish

forma.care: Wipe with a damp cloth. This is a keepsake, not a toy.
forma.designer_note: A minimal celebration arch, hand-polished and engraved with up to two names and a date.

seo.title: Arc Topper — a personalised keepsake by FORMA
seo.description: A minimal celebration arch in a food-safe finish, engraved with names and a date.

title: Arch Dental Study
subtitle: A dimensional dental reference in matte plaster.
description: A reference arch for dental studios, printed at high resolution in matte plaster. Supplied from your scan or our standard adult anatomy. Available with a magnetic split for demonstration, and a numbered base for storage.

images.alt: The Arch Dental Study in matte plaster

forma.care: Handle with care. Dust with a soft brush; do not soak.
forma.designer_note: A high-resolution reference arch, available from standard anatomy or your own scan.

seo.title: Arch Dental Study — a dimensional reference model
seo.description: A dental reference arch printed in matte plaster, from standard anatomy or your scan.
